name: Fox
description: Quick on his feet and unnaturally lucky.

passive.name: RNG Blessing
passive.description: Gain 1.5% Luck per level.

name: Sir Oofie
description: He's slow, but his armor makes him pretty chunky.

passive.name: Reinforced
passive.description: Gain 1% Armor per level.

name: Calcium
description: An undead shredder who pulls of the sickest tricks.

passive.name: Speed Demon
passive.description: Speed builds up over time, but is halved when you take damage. Also gain damage based on speed.

name: Megachad
description: He wields the perfect, most powerful jawline.

passive.name: Flex
passive.description: Flex to stop damage. Cooldown -0.2s per level. Gain 2.5% Damage when flexing.

unlock: Get the Damage Tome to level 7.

name: Ogre
description: Big and strong, with the critical thinking skills of a wet sock.

passive.name: Warrior
passive.description: Gain 1.5% Damage per level.

name: CL4NK
description: I don't know how to pronounce his name.

passive.name: Crit Happens
passive.description: Gain 1% Crit Chance per level.

name: Athena
description: Captain America but ordered from Temu. (with a 23% discount)

passive.name: Lock in
passive.description: Deal more damage on lower HP. Gain 2 Thorns per level.

unlock: Get the Thorns Tome to level 9.

name: Robinette
description: Steals from the poor, gives to the rich.

passive.name: Stonks
passive.description: Gain 1% Gold Gain per level. Also increase Damage slightly by total Gold in inventory.

name: Monke
description: No one knows where he got the shades. No one asks.

passive.name: Monke Grip
passive.description: Climp up walls. Also gain +2 Max HP per level.

unlock: Find and release Monke in the Forest.

name: Tony McZoom
description: Tony didn't choose the hoverboard - the hoverboard chose him.

passive.name: Zap
passive.description: Charge an electric attack by moving around. Gain 2% Pickup Range per level.

name: Bush
description: Just a normal bush, nothing to see here.

passive.name: Bullseye
passive.description: Random enemies are marked. Also gain 1% Crit Damage per level.

unlock: Find and defeat Bush in the Forest.

name: Birdo
description: The glasses are for your safety, not his.

passive.name: Float
passive.description: Hold "Jump" to float in the air. Also gain 1% Airborne Damage per level.

unlock: Kill 100 enemies using Tornado weapon while carried by a tornado on Desert.

name: Noelle
description: The Megabonk Discord bullied me into creating this character.

passive.name: Enduring
passive.description: Gain 0.75% Size per level. Also increase Damage per currently frozen enemy.

unlock: Use a Microwave to duplicate Ice Crystal 3 times in a row.

name: Amog
description: No one knows his real name. Everyone just started calling him Amog, and he never corrected them.

passive.name: Plague
passive.description: Poisoned enemies explode on death, poisoning nearby enemies. Also gain 1% Poison Damage per level.

name: Spaceman
description: Spaceman is currently banned from 7 planets and most NASA gift shops.

passive.name: Quantum XP Theory
passive.description: Gain 1% XP Gain per level.

name: Bandit
description: A sneaky lad with a sharp sword.

passive.name: Flowstate
passive.description: Gain 1% Attack Speed per level.

unlock: Find and defeat Bandit in the Desert.

name: Ninja
description: Very fast and elusive. Hasn't filed his taxes since 2014. He's cooked.

passive.name: Shadowstep
passive.description: Execute an enemy upon evading them. Also gain 0.5% Evasion per level.

name: Vlad
description: He looks pretty evil but he's actually a really nice dude. He always says hi at the grocery store. Chill guy.

passive.name: Vampire
passive.description: Gain 1% Lifesteal per level.

name: Sir Chadwell
description: Sir Oofie's wife's boyfriend. Bought him new armor and lets him stay up past 8:30. Nice guy!

passive.name: Curse
passive.description: Gain 1% Difficulty per level.

name: Dice Head
description: His favorite number is 7. Who's gonna tell him the bad news?

passive.name: Gamba
passive.description: Roll the dice and upgrade a random stat when you level up!

unlock: Complete 100 Quests and get the Dice.

name: Roberto
description: He claims to be floating. Scientists and experts are still investigating.

passive.name: Hoarder
passive.description: Free chest ervery 60s, increasing to 120s over levels. He can also float (a little).
